title: Hun is now $9, once
summary: Buy a lifetime license for up to 3 Macs. The free public beta ends on 31 October 2026.

groups.title: New
changes: Buy Hun for $9, once: a lifetime license for the complete app on up to 3 Macs, with no subscription.
When a beta license ends, Hun says so clearly and lets you buy and activate a license right there.

groups.title: Improved
changes: Hun checks your license every few hours and when your Mac wakes, not only at launch.
Activation messages no longer assume a two-Mac limit.

groups.title: Fixes
changes: When Docker stops responding, services that run through it show as crashed within about 20 seconds instead of staying "running".
A service that can't start now says why in its own log.

title: A steadier menu bar and calmer profiles
summary: Hun's menu bar icon stays where you put it, and choosing a profile no longer starts a stopped project.

groups.title: Improved
changes: Hun's menu bar icon now stays where you ⌘-drag it, across restarts and updates.
Choosing a profile for a stopped project just selects it; Run starts it next time. Running projects still switch instantly.
The Hun skill for coding agents is simpler: it sets up .hun.yml from your project's own commands, helps you create profiles, and always starts services through Hun.

groups.title: Fixes
changes: Clicking the menu bar icon again now closes the panel.
The menu bar panel opens aligned with its icon and shows fresh project status each time.

title: Profiles and a redesigned Hun
summary: Run just the services you need with profiles, see everything already running on your Mac, and enjoy a faster, cleaner Hun.

groups.title: New
changes: Profiles: name sets of services in .hun.yml and run one with a click or `hun run <project> -p <profile>`. Switching profiles only starts and stops the difference.
Hun now sees services started outside it (a terminal, an agent, Docker) and can stop, restart and take them over.
Edit .hun.yml inside Hun, with highlighting, line numbers and live validation.
Settings now live in the main window, with a System, Light or Dark theme switcher.
A redesigned menu bar panel, and a menu bar icon that shows when projects are running.
Resize the sidebar, and see each project's logo in its header.

groups.title: Improved
changes: Busy services no longer slow Hun down: logs stream in batches and render incrementally.
Project icons stay visible in light and dark mode, whatever their colours.
Port conflicts name what holds the port and offer to stop it.
Long project names and narrow windows are handled cleanly.

groups.title: Fixes
changes: A service printing a very long line no longer freezes.
Stopping a project's last service stops the project.
Run restarts a project whose services crashed.

title: The workspace release
summary: Hun grows from a service dashboard into a place to inspect, change, and ship the code already running around you.

groups.title: Git workspace
changes: Review branches, sync state, staged work, local changes, and untracked files without leaving the active project.
Inspect high-performance syntax-highlighted diffs, switch between staged and unstaged views, and resize the workspace around the task.
Update branches safely while preserving staged, unstaged, and untracked work, with explicit preflight and recovery states.
Generate concise commit-message suggestions from the staged diff on supported Macs, then edit before committing.

groups.title: Integrated terminal
changes: Open a persistent terminal session for each project directly beneath the workspace.
Resize the terminal with a native-feeling divider and keep sessions aligned as projects open, close, or change.

groups.title: Mac distribution
changes: Ship an Apple-silicon app signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and packaged in a drag-to-Applications DMG.
Add Sparkle-powered updates with hourly checks, a quiet in-app update banner, release notes, secure archive verification, installation, and relaunch.
Add Check for Updates to the app menu and connect every release to this versioned changelog.

title: Reliable runtimes
summary: Ports, process ownership, readiness, and dashboard continuity now agree on what is actually running.

groups.title: Runtime
changes: Keep configured ports when they are free, offset only genuine collisions, and publish the selected launch port as PORT.
Reconcile listeners only when they belong to the launched service and reject collisions with other Hun services or instances.
Recover from missing sockets, stale PID files, failed termination, and orphaned development daemons.
Keep readiness and live-port state aligned with the actual process.

groups.title: Mac app
changes: Restore the selected project, open tabs, selected service, and log scope across launches.
Crossfade project changes with Reduce Motion support and use restrained runtime status treatments.

title: Health and focus
summary: A stricter view of ports and daemon health, with safer transitions between focus and multitask work.

groups.title: Runtime
changes: Prioritize configured ports, verify live listeners, and prevent concurrent port claims.
Expose daemon health, protocol, PID, uptime, restart controls, and diagnostics in native settings.
Upgrade the daemon protocol so the app can replace stale background daemons automatically.

groups.title: Workflow
changes: Open local running services from the service card or context menu.
Keep the selected project running when switching from Multitask to Focus whenever possible.

title: Log viewer v2
summary: A dual-pane log workflow with deterministic navigation and stricter service state.

groups.title: Logs
changes: Add dual-pane keyboard and mouse routing, live mode, wrapping, deterministic scrolling, and range selection.
Improve copying with OSC52 and native clipboard fallbacks plus clear visual feedback.
Reset per-service in-memory logs and distinguish stopping a service from stopping its whole project.

title: A smoother first run
summary: Focused improvements to onboarding, documentation, and release validation.

groups.title: Experience
changes: Refresh the website and documentation around the project-first workflow.
Polish hun onboard and validate version output in the Homebrew formula.

title: Initial public release
summary: The first complete Hun workflow for running projects rather than arranging terminal sessions.

groups.title: Foundation
changes: Switch between projects in Focus mode or run several side by side in Multitask mode.
Manage services, automatic port offsets, unified logs, and the terminal UI from one daemon-backed tool.
